name: Breadcrumb
summary: A trail of ancestor links ending in the current page — and, at size=page-title, the page heading itself (there is no separate page-title component).
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-breadcrumb> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; feed it an `items` JSON array — each entry { label, href?, icon?, disabled? }: an entry with an `href` is a link, the last (or any href-less) entry is the current page (stronger colour, aria-current). A leading `icon` draws by name via <aha-icon>. `separator` picks the DS caret (default) or a slash; `maxItems` collapses the middle into an ellipsis toggle. `size` scales the trail — `default` (13/22) or `mini` (12/18) for sub-page nav, and `page-title`, where the current crumb becomes a REAL heading (`<h1>` by default, `heading-level` picks h1–h6): a single-item trail is the page title alone (Heading4 24/600), a longer trail is that heading with its ancestor path in front (18/600). This is why AhaSlides has no separate page-title component — the breadcrumb IS the page title, so a page header is never a hand-rolled <h1>. Links + the ellipsis animate on hover via the shared motion tokens. Emits a composed `navigate` event.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin wrapper that listens for `navigate`; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.name: items
props.desc: The trail; an entry with href is a link, the last / href-less entry is the current page, icon adds a leading DS glyph, disabled mutes it

props.name: size
props.desc: Scale of the trail. default 13/22 · mini 12/18 for sub-page nav; page-title renders the current crumb as the page heading (24/600 alone, 18/600 in a trail)

props.name: heading-level
props.desc: Heading tag used for the current crumb when size=page-title — an <h1> page title by default; drop to h2–h6 if the breadcrumb isn't the page's top heading

props.name: separator
props.desc: Divider glyph between crumbs — the DS caret (default) or a slash

props.name: maxItems
props.desc: Collapse the middle into an ellipsis toggle when the trail is longer than N (0 = never)

props.name: navigate
props.desc: Composed event on a link click, detail { index, href }

whenToUse.when: the heading of a product page — size=page-title makes the current crumb the page <h1>, alone or at the end of its ancestor path. This is THE page title; do not hand-roll a plain <h1>/heading
showing where a page sits in a hierarchy the user can climb back up, without heading-level prominence
the page header ROW — a page title (via this breadcrumb) plus right-aligned action buttons
switching between sibling views at the same level — not a hierarchy
a single linear step back is all that's needed

opinion.note: The page title is NOT a plain <h1> — it is <aha-breadcrumb size="page-title">, with just the current page as the only item (or the full ancestor path in front of it). A hand-rolled heading is the wrong answer: it drifts from the DS type scale and loses the built-in trail, aria-current, and navigate event. Keep breadcrumbs to the real ancestor path — don't pad them. The last item is the current page and is never a link. Labels are short nouns, sentence case.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — DS V3 Breadcrumb component set (fileKey MwjvUjVI0HnfwD9EwPXRAy, node 61346:4893) with Components/Link + Components/Separator sub-parts and a Count × Size matrix (Size = Mini / Default / Page title, Count = 1…4+). Bindings from get_variable_defs: default = Body 14 (fontSizeDefault) / lh 1.5 / ls 0.2 (Paragraph); mini = 12 (fontSizeSM) / lh 1.5 / ls 0.3 (Subtext); page-title = SemiBold 600 across the trail at Heading6 18 / lh 1.3 / ls 0.2 (Subheadings), and standalone (Count=1) at Heading4 24 / lh 1.3 / ls 0 (Headlines). Colour token-derived: text-secondary link, text-default current (aria-current, and a real heading in page-title), color-primary hover, icon-muted separator, text-disabled disabled item. Matrix covered: three sizes, page-title heading (h1–h6 via heading-level, solo vs trailed), leading item icons, caret vs slash separator, maxItems middle-collapse (ellipsis toggle), disabled item. Motion + glyphs bound to the shared motion tokens and the DS icon library. (Default kept at 13/22, matching the shipped element and its conformance probe; the Figma Default cell is 14 — within a px of the same role.)
